Subject: Re: Trial kickoff and scope

Diego — thanks again for the demo yesterday. The exec team wants a short, prescriptive MAP we can use to evaluate Redwood over a 6–8 week window and a tight close runway (target: commit by end of Q2). Specifically we need:
- Clear success criteria and pass/fail rules for the evaluation
- Explicit exit gates (what forces a stop/rollback)
- Acceptance tests we can run (both functional and performance)
- A short mutual action plan with owners and dates

We attached our PV-technical-requirements.pdf so you can align tests against our constraints (data residency, max latency ~300ms median, SOC2 evidence). Can you turn around a draft MAP by next week?

Appreciate it —
Jared

Head of Data & AI, Aurelius Health

Date: 2026-04-21T09:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff and scope — draft MAP and acceptance protocol

Thanks Jared — attached is a focused draft (redwood-map-draft.pdf) that maps tests to your PV doc and proposes a 6-week MAP. Key highlights below so it's easy to scan:

Mutual action plan (6 weeks) — high level
- Week 0 (kickoff): Align success metrics, install eval hooks, share dataset slices (Aurelius). Owners: Diego (Redwood AE), Marissa (Redwood Solutions).
- Weeks 1–3 (integration + smoke): Connector setup, initial traffic routing, prefix caching validation, smoke functional tests. Owner: Marissa.
- Week 4 (canary): 24–72h canary at scaled QPS for production-like traffic. Acceptance: no regression >2% on critical intents; median latency <300ms; P99 <700ms.
- Week 5 (validation): Full acceptance test-run (concordance, hallucination audit, throughput). Evidence: logs, eval harness results, cost projections.
- Week 6 (decision): Final scorecard and executive sync; DocuSign route if accepted.

Absolute exit gates (stop/rollback triggers)
- Any SOC2 control evidence gap preventing audit: immediate pause.
- Sustained P99 > 900ms for >30 minutes under expected load.
- Hallucination/regression spike >5% measured across predefined prompt set.

Acceptance tests (examples we will provide harnesses for)
- Latency profile (median, p95, p99) collected from token-level traces.
- Throughput test at 80–120 qps for 30–60 minutes.
- Concordance: sample set of 500 prompts, target F1/precision thresholds (we propose baseline values and will run blinded evals).
- Data leakage/residency verification checklist + sample logs for audit.

Deliverables we (Redwood) will provide
- Draft MAP + scorecard (this week) — Diego
- Eval harness + runbook (Marissa)
- SOC2 artifacts and access notes (Ben)

Open asks for Aurelius
- Share 2–3 priority prompt sets + representative traffic shape
- Confirm target commit window (you mentioned end of Q2)

If this outline looks good I can schedule a 60-minute alignment workshop (Marissa + Ben in attendance) next week and we’ll lock the detailed timeline and owners.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
